name: Dram Taster Hilary

intro.text: I've walked up from the distillery. Four miles. I've regretted three of them. The view is wonderful, though. Dear me, are you challenging me? In this state?

win: Quite right. That was a better walk than mine.
after: Always have the cheese, then the hill, then the pub. In that order, or you'll go up the hill in the wrong spirits.
